note: Cumberland County VA (FIPS 51049) zones its unincorporated land (A-2, R-1, R-MH, B-1, M-1 per Chapter 74), but the county's official zoning map is only on file at the Planning Department. The county GIS Map Service it links could not be reached, and no public ArcGIS REST zoning layer for Virginia turned up. The ArcGIS Hub 'Cumberland County Zoning' layer is Cumberland County, North Carolina, not Virginia. Third-party zoneomics pages are not an official source.
